title: Richard Feynman: "What's the name of a bird?"
summary: A short clip from a 1973 NOVA episode in which Richard Feynman recalls his father teaching him that knowing the name of a bird in many languages tells you nothing about the bird.
why: Reached for whenever a thread touches on naming versus actually understanding something.

quote.text: You can know the name of a bird in many different languages, but that tells you nothing about it.
